problem: The reusable pricing component still advertised the old Bedrijfsgeheugen Scan price €2.900 and an unsupported remote-price variant while the canonical pricing page, SaaS pricing contract and commercial offer use €2.950.
root_cause: Pricing parity controls covered /prijzen, Portal V2 entitlements and checkout, but did not include the reusable pricing component as part of the same commercial truth boundary.
prevention: Every reusable pricing component must use the same canonical commercial price as /prijzen.
Unsupported alternative prices may not survive in reusable components unless backed by an explicit canonical offer contract.
A regression test must compare the reusable component with the canonical pricing page.

evidence.outcome: Reusable pricing copy now uses €2.950 and no longer exposes the stale €2.400 remote variant.
